name: Futari Gurashi
source:
This is a love story about living together with your niece.

The couple's story starts in a normal, mundane town that you could find anywhere.
They spend their days together and eventually become attracted to each other.
But each of them has a wound from the past that keeps them from getting closer to each other.
Though their bodies mingle, their hearts do not.

This is a story about the relationship between an uncle and his niece, each carrying a wound that will never heal.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034739.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是一则与外甥女同居的爱情故事。

两人的故事始于一座随处可见的平凡小镇。
他们朝夕相处，最终被彼此吸引。
然而，两人心中各有一道来自过去的伤口，阻碍着彼此靠近。
身体即使交缠，心却无法相通。

这是一个舅舅与外甥女各自背负永不愈合的创伤，逐渐建立关系的故事。

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE034739.html]DLsite English[/url]]
